narrative.overview:
SAPI is built for the counter, not the boardroom. The palette has shifted from a cool indigo to a lush teal-green (hue 162), and the neutrals now carry a matching green undertone throughout: backgrounds, borders, and muted surfaces are all tinted toward the primary hue. The result feels grounded and earthy rather than corporate.

Light mode is the primary surface. Dark mode tokens are defined for evening use or user preference, using the same green-tinted hue family at low lightness. All tokens are CSS custom properties defined in app.css and consumed via Tailwind utilities.
keyCharacteristics: Teal-green primary (hue 162) with green-tinted neutrals across every surface
Teal Signal (success/cyan), Kunyit (warning/amber), Cabai (destructive/red-orange) semantic amplifiers
Plus Jakarta Sans primary; JetBrains Mono for transaction codes and numeric data
Light mode primary; dark mode defined and valid

rules.name: The Single Hue Rule
rules.body: Every token shares the green hue family (150–162), including neutrals. New tokens must land in this family or carry a clear semantic role.

rules.name: The Semantic Lock Rule
rules.body: Teal Signal, Kunyit, and Cabai carry exactly one meaning each: complete, pending, and void/error. Not available for decoration.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: All color usage references CSS custom properties via Tailwind utilities. Hardcoded values in component files are prohibited.

rules.name: The Mono Anchor Rule
rules.body: Transaction IDs, receipt numbers, and running totals use JetBrains Mono. It signals precision and differentiates machine codes from human text.

rules.name: The No Tiny Text Rule
rules.body: Nothing below 0.75rem (12px) in any functional context.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: No surface uses more than Ambient shadow at rest. Lift responds to interaction, not decoration.

dos: Do reference all colors via CSS custom properties and Tailwind utilities.
Do use bg-success exclusively for the BAYAR button and transaction-completion states.
Do use bg-warning exclusively for open bill and pending states.
Do use bg-destructive exclusively for void, error, and irreversible-action states.
Do use JetBrains Mono for transaction codes, receipt numbers, and numeric data.
Do keep all cashier-facing touch targets at 44px minimum height.
Do use bg-muted or bg-secondary for inner containers rather than nesting bordered cards.
Do apply the .dark class to <html> for dark mode — all tokens shift automatically.
Do keep active:scale-[0.97] on the POS product card.
Do write copy in Indonesian: Bayar, Batal, Simpan, Hapus.
donts: Don't hardcode color values in Vue components.
Don't introduce new hues outside the green family (150–162) for neutral or decorative purposes.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't design in the generic enterprise SaaS template (Salesforce / HubSpot).
Don't use consumer fintech visual language (GoPay / OVO).
Don't reproduce legacy POS density (Moka POS circa 2018).
Don't apply the Western startup cream aesthetic (Notion / Linear).
